def __setitem__(self, key, value):
    value = extract_array(value, extract_numpy=True)

    if not lib.is_scalar(key) and is_list_like(key):
        key = np.asarray(key)

    if not lib.is_scalar(value):
        value = np.asarray(value)

    values = self._ndarray
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if values.dtype.kind == 'O':  # object dtype
            values[key] = np.array([value], dtype=object)
        else:
            # find the maximum length of the string in the array
            max_len = max(len(x) for x in values)
            max_len = max(max_len, len(value))
            t = np.dtype(f'<U{max_len}')
            values = values.astype(t)
            values[key] = value
            self._dtype = PandasDtype(t)
            self._ndarray = values
    else:
        t = np.result_type(value, values)

            values = values.astype(t, casting="safe")

            self._dtype = PandasDtype(t)

            self._ndarray[key] = value
